question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this enterprise control-plane model as the umbrella direction for a sequence of focused RFCs?
rationale: The proposal creates new product and authority boundaries across tenancy, identity, authorization, ingress, runtime integrations, and administration; repository mechanics cannot determine whether those contracts are the intended platform direction.

options.title: Sponsor and split
options.body: Keep the umbrella proposal open for discussion and require focused, template-conforming RFCs before accepting any component contract.

options.title: Narrow first
options.body: Select one foundational contract, such as primitives or IAM, and defer the remaining enterprise surfaces until that RFC is accepted.

options.title: Decline the model
options.body: Close the proposal if OpenClaw should not pursue a separate enterprise control plane and authority stack.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and split
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella proposal open for discussion and require focused, template-conforming RFCs before accepting any component contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a project-wide product architecture decision rather than a mechanical formatting or implementation choice.
